answer: Ahmednagar College was founded in **1947** by Rev. Dr. Bhaskar Pandurang Hivale (Ph.D. from Harvard). It is the **first college established in Ahmednagar district** and is now managed by the BPHE Society. It's a Christian Minority Institution open to all castes, creeds, and religions.
The Principal of Ahmednagar College is **Dr. R. J. Barnabas**. For direct contact, reach the college at **0241-2359571** or email **ahmednagarcollege1947@gmail.com**.

**Address:** Station Road, Ahmednagar – 414001, Maharashtra, India
**Phone:** 0241-2359571
**Email:** ahmednagarcollege1947@gmail.com
**Website:** www.aca.edu.in

The campus is centrally located near Ahmednagar Railway Station, making it easily accessible for commuting students.

Ahmednagar College is:
• **NAAC accredited** with a B++ Grade (subject to change post-reaccreditation)
• Recognized under **Sections 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act**
• **Permanently affiliated** with **Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU)**
• Previously recognized as a **"College with Potential for Excellence"** by UGC

**Motto:** "Not Things but Men"

**Vision:** To be an institution of excellence in higher education that continually responds to changing social realities.

**Mission:** To create a teaching-learning environment that fosters critical thinking, ethical values, and social responsibility, ensuring holistic development of students.

**Undergraduate programs (3 years each):**
• **B.A.** — English, Hindi, Marathi, Economics, History, Political Science, Psychology, Sociology, Geography
• **B.Com** — Accounting, Auditing, Costing, Business Administration, Marketing
• **B.Sc (General)** — Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Zoology, Math, Statistics, Geography
• **B.Sc (Computer Science)** — Most competitive, highest placements
• **B.Sc (Biotechnology)** — Genetics, Molecular Biology, Immunology
• **B.Sc (Microbiology)** — Clinical & Industrial Microbiology
• **BCA** — Software development, web design, app development
• **BBA** — Corporate management, HR, Finance, Marketing

Admissions are merit-based on 10+2 (HSC) marks.

**Postgraduate programs (2 years each):**
• **M.A.** — English, Marathi, Hindi, Economics, History, Political Science, Psychology, Sociology
• **M.Com** — Advanced Accounting & Taxation, Cost Accounting
• **M.Sc** — Chemistry (Organic/Analytical/Drug), Physics, Botany, Zoology, Math, Microbiology, Computer Science

Admissions based on the relevant Bachelor's degree marks. M.Sc Chemistry and Computer Science have near 100% placement records.

Ahmednagar College is a **recognized Research Center under SPPU**. Ph.D. programs are available primarily in Sciences and select Arts disciplines. Departments recognized as research centers include Zoology, Chemistry, Botany, and English.

**Eligibility:** Master's degree with 55%+ marks and SPPU PET qualification (or UGC-NET/JRF).

**Approximate annual fees (Open category — subject to annual SPPU revision):**
• **B.A. / B.Com** (grantable): ₹2,400 – ₹7,400
• **B.Sc General Science:** ₹25,000 – ₹28,000
• **B.Sc Computer Science / Biotech:** ₹30,000 – ₹35,000
• **BCA / BBA:** ₹15,000 – ₹22,000
• **M.A.:** ₹2,000 – ₹15,000
• **M.Sc / M.Com:** ₹10,400 – ₹25,000

**Note:** Fees vary significantly by category (Open, OBC, SC, ST). OBC/SC/ST students get large concessions via MahaDBT. Confirm the exact amount at the admission office: **0241-2359571**.

answer:
Ahmednagar College implements all state and central government scholarship schemes:

• **MahaDBT Portal** — SC, ST, VJNT, OBC, SBC categories get freehips (full fee waiver)
• **EBC Concession** — 50% tuition fee waiver for Economically Backward Class students
• **Karmaveer Bhaurao Patil Earn & Learn Scheme** — economically weaker students can work in library or admin office for hourly stipend

Apply through the official MahaDBT portal: mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in

**Admission process for Ahmednagar College:**

1. **Online Registration** — Visit www.aca.edu.in, create a user ID and password
2. **Application Form** — Fill personal details, educational history, select course. Upload photo, signature, 10th & 12th marksheets, leaving certificate, caste certificate (if applicable)
3. **Merit List** — Based on marks and intake, successive merit lists are published on the website
4. **Document Verification** — Shortlisted candidates visit the campus with original documents
5. **Fee Payment** — Payment link activates after verification. Admission confirmed only after payment.

Admissions are entirely online via the college's ERP system.

Ahmednagar College has a **sprawling 32.9-acre green campus** blending mid-20th-century heritage architecture with modern academic blocks. The campus features:

• Central Library with 200,000+ volumes
• Separate hostels for boys (650) and girls (250)
• Multiple sports facilities — cricket, football, athletics, basketball, volleyball, tennis
• Fully equipped indoor gymnasium
• Advanced science labs with modern instrumentation
• Multiple computer labs with broadband
• 6 canteens, post office, banking facilities, auditorium, medical room

The **Central Library (Learning Resource Centre)** at Ahmednagar College is one of the largest in the district. It houses:

• **200,000+ volumes** including rare books, journals, and CDs
• Automated issue-return system
• Spacious reading hall
• Digital section with INFLIBNET N-List database access

Open to all enrolled students and faculty.

Ahmednagar College provides separate hostels:

• **Boys' Hostel** — capacity ~650 students across multiple blocks
• **Girls' Hostel** — capacity ~250 students

**Facilities include:** solar water heaters, RO drinking water, Wi-Fi zones. Both hostels are on-campus and monitored by wardens.

Contact the college for hostel admission: **0241-2359571**

**Placement highlights at Ahmednagar College:**

• **Highest package:** ~6.5 LPA (mostly B.Sc CS / BCA / MCA students)
• **Average package:** 3.3 – 3.6 LPA
• **Strong placements:** IT, Computer Science, specialized Chemistry programs
• **Moderate placements:** Arts/Commerce streams

**Top recruiters:**
• IT: Cognizant, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, TCS, Infosys
• Pharma: Lupin, Sun Pharma, Cipla, Ranbaxy, Serum Institute
• Finance: ICICI Bank, HDFC, local cooperative banks

The Training & Placement Cell runs resume workshops, mock interviews, aptitude prep, and soft-skills training (including a BPO skills certificate course) before campus drives in the final semester.

NSS participation earns credits and builds a strong social service record.
